prompt.en: Healthy lungs cannot do the whole job of breathing on their own. Explain why, using the idea of an organ system.

label.en: The lungs do only part of the job

level1.en: What do the lungs do, and what has to happen to the air before it reaches them?

clue.en: Air must first come in through the nose and pass down the windpipe before it fills the lungs.

level2Template.en: The lungs do only ___ of the job of breathing.

label.en: Several organs work together as a system

level1.en: Which other organs take part, and what do we call organs that work together on one big job?

clue.en: The nose, windpipe and lungs work together. Organs that work together on one big job form an organ system.

level2Template.en: The nose, windpipe and lungs work together as an ___.

text.en: The lungs do only part of the job: air must first come in through the nose and pass down the windpipe.
The nose, windpipe and lungs work together as an organ system, the respiratory system, to carry out breathing.
